$comment: Tools and what they cut (docs/adr/0067-stone-axe-and-chopping.md). A tool is an item (shared/inventory/inventory.json names it) with a `kind` from a fixed vocabulary (`axe`: chops the `woods`). A swing cuts `biteM` into open wood when its plane crosses the grain; its share is `along + (across - along) * |cos θ|^sharpness`, θ the angle between the swing plane's normal and the grain. Wood cut deeper than a side's open notch binds: a swing into a kerf cuts `bite / (1 + kerf / bindM)`. A chunk comes out when both bands of a side are cut past its notch. `woods`: the blocks an axe cuts (by name; their grain is their `axis` property), when a standing one falls (`fellFraction` of its cross-section cut) and a lying one is cut through (`buckFraction`), what a cut-through length drops (`buckDrops`, as a block's `drops`) and the chips a swing knocks out (`chips`: how many, their colour, speed m/s and size m; the client's particles). A tool's `held` is the item of shared/characters/characters.json a hand shows holding it for a level swing, `heldVertical` for a vertical one (two holds). A tool's `swing` is its feel and its path (the owner, 2026-11-08: weighty first-person melee): `windupS` before the arc, `activeS` the arc's sweep (the head travels `arcDeg` at `reachM` from the eye in `samples` steps, screen right to left for a level swing, top to bottom for a vertical one; the first solid cell on the path is hit, the server sweeping the same arc), `hitStopS` the pause on impact, `recoverHitS` after a hit and `recoverMissS` after a miss (a looser follow-through), `kickDeg` the camera's jolt on a hit, `staminaCost` what a swing will draw when stamina exists (unused until then), `swish` and `bounce` its sound events (shared/sounds; a bounce: not a wood). A wood's `leaves` are shaken down from that leaf block within `radiusM` and `heightM` above the hit on each hit, its `sway` leans the standing tree from `fromFraction` of the cross-section cut up to `maxDeg` at the fell fraction, and its `sounds` are each hit's sound event by the cut's fraction (`from` rising from 0). A wood's `cut` is how its cuts are carved into the cell's mesh (the client's; ADR 0067 §11): `tile` the atlas tile of the fresh-wood faces inside (shared/textures/materials.json's `tiles`; none: the block's end-grain tile) and `tint` a colour multiplying it (warm, so the wood stays tan in shade under the sky's and the ground's light), `open` the notch's opening along the grain per metre of its depth (its V), `kerfWidthM` the kerf slits' width. A block's `breakWith` (shared/blocks) names the tool kind breaking it needs where blocks are not unlimited (adventure: logs need an axe). Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/tools/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if the generated files are stale.
